name: icebound-slam-on-attack-mills-five-four-water-no-bonus
notes: Icebound Slam (6fxxgmuesd) played by player 2 (turn 2: the opening player can't activate attack cards on turn 1) with a WATER lineage; no Class Bonus, so it costs its printed 7. Deck top after player 2's turn-start draw: five cards: four Spirit of Water (WATER) and a Dungeon Guide then Charge the Soul (marker: must be the new top card). On Attack mills five; only four water cards -> no bonus (3 damage). Pre-fix the generated body milled with a loop of MZMove(myDeck-0), so only ONE card was milled (graveyard 2, deck 18, 3 damage).

rulesClauses: On Attack: Put the top five cards of your deck into your graveyard. Then if there are five or more water element cards in your graveyard, Icebound Slam gets +5 POWER.
